_metadata.purpose: LEDGER Q58: classify banned/recalled records whose policy is unverified (a confirmed match is quarantined, so a scan answers 'not found'). No routing changed.

categories.1: identity verified, safety concern evidenced (Q57b), no US regulatory determination: candidate BLOCKED with 'Unverified ingredient' (or the label its legal status supports)
categories.2: regulatory action evidenced by an authoritative source naming the record: candidate policy-verified BLOCKED with the specific reason
categories.2-pending: regulatory action known to exist but the record lacks the source that names it: attach and read it, then category 2
categories.3: identity, match scope or basis not sufficient: stay quarantined until reviewed
categories.4: recall claimed but no recall record found: stay quarantined until verified

_metadata.method: scoring_v4.gate_safety requirement functions; each attached authoritative URL fetched and searched for the record's names; recalls looked up in openFDA food/drug enforcement by recall number, else by product name
_metadata.today_impact: 0 of the 38 brand scored outputs are quarantined for safety_policy_review_required; all 73 shipped BLOCKED products come from verified records
